timeframe_aligner_causality.rule: Higher timeframe bars are strictly invisible until their close timestamp t_close <= t_ltf.

structure_engine_confirmation.rule: Swings require N >= 2 subsequent bars before confirmation; unconfirmed pivots are inaccessible to bias classifier.

execution_fill_causality.fill_model: Next-bar open or limit fill; no intrabar peek on entry trigger bar.
execution_fill_causality.adverse_first_collision: Adverse stop loss evaluated before take profit on dual-touch bars.
